scope: Underlying Vivado command and report verification, not ROSS MCP integration

official_faults.description: AMD multi-violation source, unchanged; target part adapted to the competition part

old_faults.description: Reconstructs the three defect mechanisms in the archived old control

clean_guard.description: Fully assigned combinational mux and XOR; no expected lint violations

modulo_guard.description: Intended modulo-256 arithmetic: an overflow warning is not permission to widen the port

acceptance.tool_validity: All commands finish without tool/environment errors; reports and inputs are traceable
acceptance.lint_engine: At least the AMD fault control must produce a nonzero linter count with a consistent parse; clean guard should remain zero
acceptance.zero_count: Zero on diagnostic-positive controls means the diagnostic mechanism is unverified, not that the design is correct
acceptance.semantic_guard: No code is changed; warnings on specified modulo arithmetic do not establish a functional bug

limitations: No model repair or gain measurement
No official MCP binary installed or called
The sample README's exact expected count uses a different device; we report differences rather than assert equivalence
No hidden reference or official testbench provided to any model
Protected package, baseline, official judge and shared model remain unchanged
